investigations.title: Image Generation Stream Eval Failure: SESSION_OPEN_FAILED (404) on /api/generate/image/stream in production-api
investigations.summary: The image-generation-stream eval for the production-api runtime environment failed immediately with a SESSION_OPEN_FAILED error carrying a 404 status, indicating the agent runtime harness endpoint was unreachable when the probe called /api/generate/image/stream. Because the session could not be opened, the stream never emitted a generation_completed frame and no image URL was produced, causing both contract assertions to fail.
investigations.rootCause: The agent runtime harness backing /api/generate/image/stream returned a 404 at session-open time in the production-api environment. The stream emitted generation_start followed immediately by generation_error with code SESSION_OPEN_FAILED and the message "agent runtime endpoint not found (404): the harness is unreachable or running an incompatible version." This prevented the stream from reaching the generation_completed frame or producing an image URL, violating both assertions in the expected-output contract. The failure is localized to the agent runtime harness reachability or version compatibility for the production-api runtime environment; no sibling checks failed and no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the evidence, so this is scoped to the eval infrastructure surface against the production-api endpoint.
